ModMetaData.name: Stop Random Relation
ModMetaData.author: Hiroaki Yamamoto and Gemini
ModMetaData.description:
Dynamically prunes unneeded pawn relationships so world pawns can be garbage-collected without losing "uninvited family relations" storytelling while pawns are active on your maps.
Features: - Preserves blood and spouse relations between living or resurrectable colonists; severs them once a deceased colonist's corpse is destroyed or desiccated. - Preserves colonist-to-world-pawn relations while the relative is alive on a colonist map, and severs them immediately on map exit or death. - Preserves world-pawn-to-world-pawn relations while both are alive on a colonist map, and severs off-map world pawn relations. - Protects living faction leaders from garbage collection even when they have no remaining family ties. - All rules are configurable in Mod Settings and take effect immediately without restarting.
